profile: Systems Engineer and Data Engineer. I build production data pipelines with Dagster, Python and dbt over a SQL Server DWH, and MCP tooling that lets AI operate real infrastructure — all under strict TDD. Cut a monthly forecast from ~18h to ~61 min with byte-identical output. Looking for Data Engineer or AI Engineer roles, remote across LATAM.

responsibilities: Optimized a monthly demand forecast (~23,000 series) from ~18 hours to ~61 minutes in production, parallelizing with ProcessPoolExecutor and pruning dead series, with output byte-identical to the sequential baseline and deterministic. Delivered under strict TDD (30 tests) with no new dependencies.

Turned operating production infrastructure —orchestration, database queries and deployments— into something handled from an AI assistant, building a fleet of 6 self-built MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers with a read-only validator, two-step confirmation and ~10-20x payload reduction on wide reads.

Cut false positives in the credit portfolio's compliance control by 94%, building the RPA that screens it against international restricted lists with fuzzy matching, without losing a single true positive. Validated and signed off by the Compliance team.

Automated the daily reconciliation between the payments system and the bank, integrating its H2H REST API (OAuth2 with credentials in HashiCorp Vault) with an incremental dbt model and 4 data-quality asset checks; 9 chained PRs with 1,524 tests.

Recovered a CRM ingestion that was silently dropping most records while every run stayed green; reloaded millions of rows with no duplicates and, by measuring dlt worker contention, raised load throughput from 91 to 368 rows/s (4x).

Brought security auditing into the delivery cycle for production applications: column-level access control over sensitive figures, credential-exposure review in logs, and input validation on file ingestion, with every finding remediated and covered by regression tests.
experience.technologies: Python, Dagster, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, dbt, Polars, Docker, HashiCorp Vault, MCP, GraphQL, OAuth2, pytest, TDD, SDD

responsibilities: Automated the VITEK-CRM integration with FastAPI and ASTM/HL7 protocols in production for bidirectional processing of culture results, with message traceability, automatic retries and logging.
Modeled clinical catalogs with SQLModel ORM (7,429 microorganisms, 278 antibiotics) with complex relationships between antibiogram headers and details.

Designed and deployed corporate proxy infrastructure with Docker, Squid and OpenVPN connecting operations across Honduras, Guatemala and El Salvador, reducing management of 30+ machines to a single point.
Implemented a referral commission system that automates the calculation on referred laboratory services, with validations preventing duplicates and safeguarding financial transaction integrity.
experience.technologies: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, SQLModel, Docker, WebSocket, ASTM, HL7, VITEK, OpenVPN

responsibilities: Designed the technical architecture documentation for a community payments system with RESTful services, NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and AWS services (S3, SNS).
Built the real-time notifications feature —endpoints, models and backend services— letting users receive instant alerts on relevant updates.

Implemented E2E tests with Playwright for critical flows (login, forms, quotes, handshake) and automated API testing with Postman/Apidog, building reusable collections and test scripts, and documenting the APIs with Swagger for maintainability.
Wrote and executed manual test cases in Jira to verify system integrity, reporting and documenting critical bugs with precise reproductions.
